content: If the bufferSizePtr provided by the API PduR_SomeIpTp StartOfReception()or PduR_SomeIpTpCopyRxData()is smaller than the sum of the re- ceived and the added SOME/IP header (in case of the first segment) or the received payload (in case of any subsequent segment), • The current assembly process shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_SomeIp Tp_00054. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError()shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_ASSEMBLY_INTERRUPT.
